description: Curated capability set (PG.2b). Grants ONLY the window controls and file dialogs the WASM frontend actually invokes; everything else VEdge does — all file I/O, HIBP, clipboard, OS info — is Rust-side (thick core) and needs no frontend capability. Replaces the uncurated `tauri migrate` files (migrated.json + desktop.json), which handed the renderer shell:allow-execute, the whole fs:* family and http:default. Each grant below was proven used by a frontend grep; see docs/changelogs PG.2b.
